# DieHardNation

Independent fan-gear aggregator and sports hub. We compare officially
licensable jerseys, hoodies, hats and apparel from eBay and Amazon across
college and pro teams, leagues and major events, plus buying guides, live
price ranges and authenticity guidance.

Not affiliated with any team, league, conference, the NCAA, or any
manufacturer. Products are sold by third-party retailers; we earn affiliate
commissions on qualifying purchases. Listings update daily.

## Coverage
- College: all 130+ FBS schools across the SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC and more.
- Pro: NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL teams; league-level hubs for major US/global leagues.
- Events: World Cup, Super Bowl, March Madness, World Series, Stanley Cup,
  Olympics and other major sporting events ("moment" gear pages).

## Pages
/[school] — College team fan-gear hub (e.g. /georgia, /texas-am)
/[school]/gear/[sport] — Sport-specific college gear
/team/[team] — Pro team fan-gear hub
/league/[league] — League-level gear hub
/events/[event] — Event/"moment" gear pages
/sport/[sport] — Sport-level hub
/trending — Most-popular gear right now
/news — Latest sports and gear news
